FILE: app/notes/preview-controls.json
```json
{
  "drag": true,
  "wheel": true,
  "pinch": false
}
```

I read the camera declarations and wrote `notes/preview-controls.json`. I inferred that mouse dragging is handled through `pointerMappings` as rotation, mouse wheel is implied by `wheelPrecision`, and the declarations do not expose a pinch/touch-zoom control, so I marked pinch as `false`. I was not completely sure about pinch because the declarations do not explicitly describe how touch gestures behave when `attachControl` is called without a scene.
